 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+The project has no test files yet, so a test run currently collects nothing. The commands below are the intended workflow once tests are added.
+
+Tests run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). It is not declared as a project dependency, so install it first:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pip install pytest
+```
+
+Run the whole suite from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file, or a single test within it:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+python3 -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Useful flags: `-v` for one line per test, `-x` to stop at the first failure, and `-k <expression>` to select tests by name.
+
+Test files live in `tests/` and follow pytest's default discovery rules: files named `test_*.py`, functions named `test_*`.
